note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors. Nominations were received by Mr. J. H. Harvey on 6 May 1936. Only nine nominations were forthcoming for the twenty seats; the nine were declared elected and the other eleven retiring members, from whom no papers were received, were deemed re-elected. Polling in County Down was fixed for 28 May 1936. Filed on 1936-06-04, the polling day for county council and rural district elections in Co. Down that year (confirmed); previously filed under 1936-05-28 (verification 5 Nov 2026). The members deemed re-elected in the divisions with no nomination are recorded from reports of the council's meetings early in the term (Banbridge Chronicle), each with its division from the previous return or from the co-option report naming the predecessor (meetings pass, 7 Nov 2026). Division inferred from the 25 May 1933 return (J. Dugan, Tierkelly); the Banbridge Chronicle, 19 December 1936, p. 2 names the member as sitting on the council early in the term. First attendance found 14 December 1936 (six months and ten days after polling day); no co-option for Tierkelly in the term. Deemed re-elected (no nomination).
